title: Fontaines D.C., Charli XCX, RAYE & More: 10 Unmissable Reading & Leeds Festival Sets
summary: The dual-festival features four first-time headliners.
contentText:
The U.K. has been spoiled when it comes to major outdoor concerts throughout recent summers. In 2025, these shores hosted Oasis ‘ big comeback, Beyoncé galloping into town with her Cowboy Carter run, Sam Fender making the leap to stadium stardom, as well as appearances from Dua Lipa and Lana Del Rey . Since then, 2026’s slate has seen Harry Styles , Bruno Mars and The Weeknd dominate the nation’s biggest venues.

Festivals have had to work hard to keep pace with these superstar names, who are frequently choosing to pursue their own headline shows as opposed to appearing on a wider bill. Reading & Leeds Festival (Aug. 28-Aug. 30) is no different: For 2026’s edition, the dual-festival (held on Richfield Avenue in Reading, and Bramham Park, Leeds) has opted for serious reinvention to meet consumer demands.

The site has been remodelled in its biggest shake-up in 27 years, with a number of new venues and a growing attention to the festival experience, as Gen Z demands more bang for its buck with competition rife. The 2026 edition will feature yoga classes and grooming stations, a far cry from the festival’s origins as a heavy rock festival featuring performances from Pink Floyd, The Who and Deep Purple, and its recent reputation as a messy blow-out for students celebrating (or commiserating over) their exam results.

The lineup, too, has been turbocharged, with six huge headliners and a strong undercard of rising acts. There are a number of first-time headliners, with Fontaines D.C., Charli xcx, RAYE, and Chase & Status all stepping up to the plate, while Dave and Florence + the Machine bring experience from their previous Reading & Leeds slots.

With the weekend fast approaching, these are Billboard U.K.’s essential performances to watch across the weekend.
